items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Billy come in and says to Ralph, he said, 'Oh, baby, take us a year to build him up.

ctx.x: So we're up there, and Billy Shaw was in California when all this was transpiring, and he came in that

morning that I went to the office that evening with Ralph. And so finally he talked me into -- well, Ralph talked me into it, and I signed a year's contract with him. I said, 'Okay, okay.' Billy come in and says to Ralph, he said, 'Oh, baby, take us a year to build him up. We need at least a three-year contract.'
